name: MusiCraft AI
tagline: AI music agent to create, split, master and transcribe music
description: MusiCraft AI brings music creation and audio tools into one workspace with a chat based AI agent. Generate full songs from a prompt, a hum or a photo, remix and extend tracks, and split any mix into stems across 66 modes. Clean and master audio, then transcribe recordings into sheet music, MIDI or MusicXML, or scan printed scores from a photo or PDF.
